name: symtony/symfony-bundle
description: Send traces, exceptions and logs from Symfony (or any Monolog app) to SYMTONY for incident reconstruction.

suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Automatic request, controller, exception and terminate tracing
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: Database query and transaction spans (DBAL middleware)
suggest.symfony/http-client: Outgoing HTTP spans and traceparent propagation
suggest.symfony/messenger: Queue dispatch/handle spans with trace propagation
suggest.symfony/cache: Cache hit/miss spans with item age
suggest.ext-curl: Faster event delivery (falls back to PHP streams)
